                         MID-TERMEXAMINATION

                           (ODD Sem: January, 2023)

Subject Code: HMC 110                    Subject: Communication Skills
Time : 1 ½ Hours                                                   Maximum Marks : 30
Note: Q.1 is compulsory. Attempt any two parts from Q2 and Q3. Read the questions
carefully before writing the answers. For all questions of 5 marks (except 2a) give a
brief Introduction and then use two paragraphs to write the answer. There is no word
limit but use time wisely to attempt all questions as per the instructions.

Q1      Explain the following in three points :                (2.5*4)          CO
                                                                               Mapping
        (a)    Clarity and Concreteness in 7Cs                                   CO1
        (b)    Disadvantages of Plagiarism                                       CO2
        (c)    Proxemics and its Zones                                           CO2
        (d)    Importance of Listening                                           CO1

Q2      Attempt any TWO from the following:                          (5,5)CO
                                                                         Mapping
        (a) Rearrange the Following into a meaningful paragraph. Only mention
        the sequence in the answer sheet.
            A. Despite the strong performance of the economy in 2010-     CO1
               11, the outlook for 2011-12 is clouded by stubborn and
               persistently high inflation, and rising external risks.
            B. The three key macroeconomic concerns before the Union
               Budget 2011-12 were high inflation, high current account
               deficit (CAD), and fiscal consolidation.
            C. Additionally, there was an expectation that the
               government would restart the reform process.
            D. While the Budget sets a lower nominal gross domestic
               product (GDP) growth target of 14%, we believe that the
               real GDP growth target of 9% factored in the Budget is on
               the optimistic side.
            E. The Budget has made an attempt to address all these
               issues, albeit through small steps.

        (b) With power comes great responsibility. In the light of this           CO1
        statement discuss the importance of Netiquette for users of Internet
        and explain any two rules in detail.

(c) Our Voice can be used as an apt tool to communicate                    CO 1
          effectively. Explain the above statement and discuss the role of
          paralanguage in communicating meaning beyond words.
Q3        Attempt any TWO from the following:                       (5,5)        CO
                                                                                Mapping
          (a)Barriers cannot be eliminated completely but they can be             CO2
          reduced. Do you agree with the above statement? Differentiate
          between Fear of Superiors and Negative Tendencies (with
          example) as barriers leading to unsuccessful communication.
          (b) Listening and Hearing appear to be same but they are                  CO2
          different activities. Give your opinion regarding the above and
          explain any two barriers of listening in your own words along with
          their remedies.
          (c) Group Discussions are an appropriate method to check the              CO2
          suitability of any candidate. Keeping this statement in mind
          discuss any two parameters on which a candidate is evaluated in a
          Group Discussion.
